expanded_semantics.P7: P7 is a reverse-engineered structural postulate/input, not a forward derivation.
expanded_semantics.anomaly_su33: In the declared convention A(8)=0 and A(6)=7, so an adjoint plus one sextet is anomalous.
expanded_semantics.health: For the declared constant-background quadratic ansatz, necessary transverse health conditions are Z>0 and Z-Y/2>0. They are not sufficient for a generic background.
expanded_semantics.lambda_col: b0=11 running and dimensional transmutation are standard supplied pure-SU(3) mathematics, not an ECT prediction.
expanded_semantics.min_eft: The displayed colour action is one declared leading truncation after a supplied bundle, connection, field content and power counting. It is not a complete or minimal physical basis.
expanded_semantics.no_oscillator: An oscillator tower is not universally excluded from a gauge-invariant physical spectrum. Only an internal tower for which no gauge-invariant operator/state/spectral map has been supplied cannot be identified with the established QCD/glueball gap.
expanded_semantics.obs_condensate: A nontrivial irreducible representation has no invariant vector, but a reducible representation containing a trivial singlet supplies a counterexample to the old universal condensate no-go. A fundamental 3 VEV has SU(2) stabiliser only under that stated representation.
expanded_semantics.openlist: P7 does not derive the colour connection, physical action, matter content, confinement or mass gap.
expanded_semantics.proton: Colour triality supplies only a colour-singlet constraint. It does not derive a global U(1)_B, a conserved baryon current, the absence or presence of a baryon-violating vertex, or a proton-decay selection rule. All three proton-stability patterns remain Level C/Open.
expanded_semantics.strong_cp: The gauge topological term g_s^2 theta_gauge F^a_{mu nu} Ftilde^{a mu nu}/(32 pi^2) is allowed by the truncation but is not forced. The physical bar-theta also contains the quark-mass phase arg det M_q, with the relative sign fixed by convention.
expanded_semantics.three_way: HKLoc/polymer material is an incomplete attempted entry criterion. Local heat-kernel lemmas do not establish the physical four-dimensional mass gap.
expanded_semantics.y_alpha: Wilson coefficients in different sectors are independent. A Y-to-alpha_ECT identification requires a common action and explicit matching and remains Open.
